title: Excused from competition, and carrying warning signs
question: Which suppliers with $1 million or more in no-competition contracts also carry warning signs in the rest of this project’s files?
finding: 118 suppliers with $1 million or more in no-competition contracts since July 2018 also carry warning signs elsewhere in this project. For 39 of them the strongest sign is an official finding, a charge or a proven case; together those 39 hold $1.25 billion in such contracts.
how: The suppliers from the previous screens, matched by name to this project’s warning-sign file (the “flagmap” results), which gathers every sign other screens have attached to an organization. Signs that only restate the no-bid award are dropped. A supplier is listed when its strongest sign is an official finding, a charge or a proven case, or when it carries three or more separate leads.
limits: Name match. The warning signs come from other screens; nothing here adds to them. Being excused from competition and being named in an audit are separate facts, and most of the awards came before the finding. The match can miss a supplier keyed under a different name.
